draft_en.subject: PoE switches for your CCTV kits - a managed 8-port and two budget units
draft_en.body:
Hello,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 10 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the PoE switches you list with CCTV kits (ONV today), neutral-brand units at distributor price, EXW, from single pieces, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD; budget 4 x PoE+ + 2 x Gigabit - STC-204GP - $24.2; 8 x PoE+ + 2 x Gigabit - STC-028GP - $25.1.

One question: which PoE port count do your Portuguese installer customers buy most - 4 or 8?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
